name: high-speed-card-relocation
intent: Card vanishes mid-travel while two afterimages mark the path; card reappears docked in slot B.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Card appears directly in slot B; no travel or afterimages

acceptance: During travelling phase the live card is opacity 0 / hidden — only ghostCount 2 afterimages are visible
Ghosts spawn at ghostLeftPct [0,25] with lifeMs [220,150] and spawnAt [0,60]
After travelMs 200 card is visible docked in slot B; slot A empty
Replay returns card to slot A before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) places card in slot B immediately
